economy.summary: Supports raising Pennsylvania's minimum wage, which her campaign notes has not changed in over a decade, and backs support for labor, infrastructure, and business development; she introduced legislation directing $300 million to the childcare industry for recovery and workforce development.
economy.short: Supports raising minimum wage; introduced $300 million childcare funding bill.

taxes.summary: Supports increasing the state's share of public school funding to reduce local school districts' reliance on property taxes, and backs grant programs for municipal improvements and facilities.
taxes.short: Supports more state school funding to reduce property-tax reliance.

abortion.summary: Says she is committed to protecting a woman's right to control her own body and has co-sponsored legislation to codify access to safe and legal abortion into Pennsylvania law.
abortion.short: Co-sponsored legislation to codify access to safe, legal abortion.

education.summary: Supports increasing Pennsylvania's state contribution to education funding, which her campaign says ranks 44th of 50, along with investments in early childhood education and pre-K, charter school accountability reforms, and making higher education more accessible and affordable.
education.short: Supports more state education funding, pre-K investment, charter accountability.

healthcare.summary: Says healthcare is a human right; introduced Senate Bill 240 to establish safe nurse-to-patient staffing ratios in hospitals and supported $20 million in student loan reimbursement for nurses.
healthcare.short: Introduced nurse-staffing-ratio bill; supported nurse student-loan reimbursement.

energy.summary: Introduced Senate Bills 611 and 612 to set contaminant limits for PFAS 'forever chemicals' in drinking water, and opposes placing the financial burden of water safety improvements on ratepayers.
energy.short: Introduced bills limiting PFAS chemicals in drinking water.

guns.summary: Supports background checks on all gun sales, closing loopholes that allow domestic abusers and stalkers to access firearms, and allowing local governments to pass their own gun ordinances.
guns.short: Supports universal background checks; closing domestic-abuser firearm loopholes.

economy.summary: In a candidate profile shared by the Montgomery County Republican Committee, Costello says he wants to reduce burdensome regulations and replace crumbling infrastructure.
economy.short: Says he wants reduced regulations and replaced crumbling infrastructure.

taxes.summary: In a candidate profile shared by the Montgomery County Republican Committee, Costello says he wants to restore fiscal responsibility and increase accountability in government; the profile does not detail specific tax proposals.
taxes.short: Says he wants fiscal responsibility and government accountability; no tax specifics.

education.summary: In a candidate profile shared by the Montgomery County Republican Committee, Costello, described as an educator, says he wants to invest in education at every level.
education.short: Says he wants to invest in education at every level.

guns.summary: In a candidate profile shared by the Montgomery County Republican Committee, Costello says he wants to support law enforcement; the profile does not address gun policy directly.
guns.short: Says he wants to support law enforcement; no gun-policy detail.
